title: Residual part of a word
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, define its residual part to be its middle part if it passes the variable test; otherwise, if it passes the one-operation test, take its body; otherwise take its second residual part.
caveat: The variable test, one-operation test, middle part, body, and second residual part are not defined in the supplied material.
